ai_runs_completion.name: ai_runs_completion
ai_runs_completion.value: ("ai_runs"."status" = 'running' and "ai_runs"."finished_at" is null) or ("ai_runs"."status" <> 'running' and "ai_runs"."finished_at" is not null)

catalogue_rows_price_shape.name: catalogue_rows_price_shape
catalogue_rows_price_shape.value:
(
    (num_nonnulls("catalogue_rows"."rent_per_month_minor", "catalogue_rows"."buy_minor") >= 1 and num_nonnulls("catalogue_rows"."per_day_minor", "catalogue_rows"."per_shift_minor", "catalogue_rows"."flat_minor") = 0)
    or ("catalogue_rows"."rent_per_month_minor" is null and "catalogue_rows"."buy_minor" is null and num_nonnulls("catalogue_rows"."per_day_minor", "catalogue_rows"."per_shift_minor", "catalogue_rows"."flat_minor") = 1)
  )

deliveries_status.name: deliveries_status
deliveries_status.value: ("deliveries"."status" = 'simulated_sent' and "deliveries"."simulated_message_id" is not null) or ("deliveries"."status" = 'cancelled' and "deliveries"."simulated_message_id" is null)

reviews_input.name: reviews_input
reviews_input.value: "reviews"."draft_revision" > 0 and length(btrim("reviews"."reply")) between 1 and 4000 and length("reviews"."reason") <= 1000
